description: This is a unit test source file for the WPEFramework's DataElement and DataStore classes, using Google Test framework. It tests various functionalities like copying data, CRC calculation, searching, bit operations, and linked data structures.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Class representing a data buffer with copy and size operations.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Class representing a data element with various methods for data manipulation and validation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Linked list structure for data elements.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for DataElement data.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement is valid.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a specific number within DataElement.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number at a specified position within DataElement.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number from a specified position within DataElement.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence within DataElement.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bits in DataElement data.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bits from DataElement data.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific offset within DataElement.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns DataElement data according to specified type.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Encloses one DataElement within another.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets the buffer within a LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer from a LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the count of linked data elements.
